column1: # Aliases the join check (join_check.py screen) searches for in each proposed row's entry line.
# archive_id <TAB> alias. A Latin alias matches as a whole word, case- and accent-insensitive;
# an Arabic-script alias matches as a plain substring. These are reading aids for the SCREEN only:
# a hit is a candidate to be read, never a decision. Add an alias whenever a reader finds a clue
# the screen missed (say so in the run record).
